title: Manage Azure subscriptions
content:
Create Azure subscription

To order a new Azure subscription (should be done by DevOps team) please use form, Azure subscription - Help Portal (service-now.com)

Use legal entity: 7001 Inter IKEA Systems B.V.

Ask PO to supply cost center and project id and supply as string: cost center/project id

Default budget limit is 500 EUR

For all Azure subscriptions: PO, and should be set as owners for the governing security groups for backup purposes.

For non production subscriptions: Add current security group for team and as well DevOps group to the contributors group

For production subscriptions: Add a couple of persons from team e.g. development lead as contributors and add security group for team as well as DevOps group as readers


For other support log issue in service desk:

cloud service desk

or

contact cloud support at: cloud.services@inter.ikea.com


Cancel Azure subscription

When you do not need the subscription the responsible for the subscription must cancel it.
